body: Follows tsk_01a12973e6b172a7b63aeafef55516fb (Batch on Hatchet). That wave ships the status-poll safety net (option A) behind the new completion-source seam. Later, evaluate a native completion source built on Hatchet parent/child workflows (option B) or guaranteed run-end delivery on Hatchet (declaring CapRunFinished once every terminal run, cancelled ones and ends while no worker ran included, is proven live), and pick the best.
title: Revisit Batch on Hatchet: the best possible way
